comparison.objective: Roll a fallen robot dog off its propping legs, remove its belly battery, and place it on a charging pad; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-body reorientation followed by component extraction and placement.
comparison.success_condition: Battery is removed from the fallen robot and placed on the charging pad; stability and extraction thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Reorienting a robot and extracting a battery differs from fracture finishing of installed inserts and recovery of four tangs.
